text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INC-5123 created by pagerduty-bot — streaming decode p99 spike detected in us-west1. p99 crossed 1.8s (SLO 600ms). Impact: streaming endpoints /v1/stream and /v1/chat (partial stalls). Assigned: maria

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty runbook link: https://redwood/pd/INC-5123 — paging eng-oncall

maria: I'm on it. Jumping to dashboards, starting with live p99/p95 graphs.

maria: quick check — deploy history shows kernel-rt v2.1.4 rolled 09:12 UTC (small driver bump + TRT8 flashattn release).

liam: I saw anomalies in KV eviction metrics earlier, could be cold cache + new kernel.

maria: Confirming: streaming tail latency shows long tails starting ~09:18 UTC across many hosts. CPU low, GPU busy, NVME io ops spike on some hosts.

josh: Any recent compilepath or compiler flags flipped?

maria: Yes — build-bot rolled compile flag `-Xft-enable-fast-alloc` in last kernel build (ci#2245). Suspect interaction with TRT flashattn kernel.

liam: Reproducer on staging: enabling that flag increases decode stalls under concurrent streaming. Repro script below:

```
# run load against staging streaming worker
./scripts/load_stream.sh --concurrency 120 --model gpt-medium --stream
```

maria: Running `redwoodctl tail logs` for affected hosts now.

sre-bot: Noted spike in p99 across us-west1 and eu-west1 (fallbacks engaged). Autoscaler triggered burst nodes.

maria: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Route traffic away from nodes with new kernel -> soft-reroute; 2) Pin runtime to pre-flag kernel variant where possible; 3) fallback to non-TRT model variant for hot routes; 4) collect samples and traces for root cause.

josh: +1. Can we set a route-level fallback to `gpt-medium-v1-safe` while we investigate?

maria: Doing that now: `redwoodctl route update /v1/stream --fallback-model gpt-medium-v1-safe --pool us-west1-safe`

maria: Running a rolling kernel rollback on 4/8 affected worker pools (canary then expand) — command:

```
# rollback kernel on pool us-west1-pool-a
kubectl set image ds/inference-worker inference-worker=redwood/inference:kernel-rt-2.1.2 --namespace=prod-us-west1
```

maria: Canary done on 2 hosts, p99 dropped from ~2.4s -> 610ms on those hosts. Prometheus charts show improvement in canary.

tara: Noted customer threads: CS has two customers reporting intermittent streaming stalls. @customer-success please prepare impact note.

customer-success: Acknowledged. Drafting message: "We experienced elevated streaming latency from 09:18–09:45 UTC. We routed traffic to safe pools and rolled back a kernel flag; we're monitoring for full recovery." Will post after you confirm details.

liam: Collected perf samples (perf, nvprof) from one affected host. Attaching short log excerpt:

```
[09:20:12] decode: kv-evict triggered, lat=1.9s, nvme_qdepth=128
[09:20:13] gpu0: kernel flashattn_v2 exec time spike -> 450ms (expected 60ms)
[09:20:14] swap_cache: increased misses
```

maria: Looks like flashattn kernel path amplifies eviction stalls. Repro in staging with `-Xft-enable-fast-alloc` toggles behavior.

josh: Next: create a compile pipeline rollback PR to revert the flag and run a full perf sweep. Also open triage issue for TRT/FlashAttn vendor to confirm compatibility.

maria: Created issue RED-4021 with logs and perf traces. PR to revert flag: https://git.redwood/infra/merge_requests/6789 — linking to incident.

sre-bot: Alert: p99 returned within SLO in us-west1 after rollback on canary hosts, overall cluster p99 650ms and trending down.

maria: Expanding rollback to remaining pools now. Est ETA full recovery ~ 25 minutes.

josh: I'll own postmortem and coord with applied-ml to validate TRT/FlashAttn kernel compatibility matrix.

maria: Handoff to josh for long-running follow-ups. If anything regresses ping me.

josh: Handoff accepted. Summary for post-incident: root cause suspected interaction between new compile flag `-Xft-enable-fast-alloc` and TRT/FlashAttn kernel causing KV eviction amplification and long decode stalls under streaming concurrency. Mitigations: route fallback, canary kernel rollback, revert compile flag, vendor follow-up.

maria: Thanks team. I'll update incident timeline in the runbook. :thumbsup:

customer-success: Sending customer note now. Will include timeline and current status.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-5123: severity reduced to SEV2, monitoring.

josh: Postmortem owner assigned: josh. Action items logged in RED-4021 and RED-4022 (tests and rollout gating).

maria: Closing thread — please add any extra context to RED-4021.
